# EML Attachment Remover 3.0.3

This corrective release completes the source-bound mutation qualification after
cross-platform terminal-report hardening. It keeps the v3 MIME-pruned safety
boundary unchanged: retained `text/plain` and `text/html` payloads remain source
bytes, only explicitly authorized attachment or related non-root subtrees are
removed, and ambiguous input is rejected rather than guessed. Retain originals and
regenerate any v2-derived files from those originals.

Verify downloaded artifacts before installation:

```sh
shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify remove-eml-attachments.pyz --repo resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover
python3.14 remove-eml-attachments.pyz --version
```
